title: G6 Sensor Stopped after Missed Readings
symptom: A 2.5-day-old Dexcom G6 sensor stopped randomly after missed readings, with no evidence of accidental stop in logs. The Stop Sensor menu option was still available, requiring a switch to a new sensor. The issue recurred about 2.5 days into a session after missed readings.
evidence_quote: This has not happened again since September. I am still using the same device and settings I was. No idea what caused this or other issues I used to get.
